Phase 1 of the creature movement/appearance perf plan (creature-perf-analysis/plan.md): cache collision/melee radii + max arm reach and per-leg partner topology at construction instead of recomputing per pairwise check / per fixed step; gate the second per-substep applyBodyTerrainClearance on a _collisionMoved flag set by resolveCreatureCollisions; skip the foot-normal terrainNormal resample for planted/non-turning feet via a cached leg._footQuat; reuse leg._hipWorld for the render localToWorld; and give trunkIndex.nearby an optional out-array so creature steering stops allocating a fresh trunk list per creature per frame. Constant-factor GC/CPU wins, no behavior change.

Phase 2 of the creature perf plan (creature-perf-analysis/plan.md): pool the per-frame arm IK/constraint Vector3 allocations (shoulderWorld, armRestTarget, constrainArmTarget/Point, carry targets) into per-arm scratch fields, and make convexHull write the support polygon into a module-scope pooled buffer instead of allocating p/lo/up/concat arrays per fixed step. Verified KinematicChain.solve does not mutate its root/target args, so reusing the buffers is safe; combat-punch and chooseArmObject clones left as-is per plan. No behavior change.

Phase 3.1 of the creature perf plan: on authored maps, back the terrainHeight() closure with a bilinear CPU heightfield instead of a per-call BVH raycast. Reuses the Float32Array the grass bakeHeightTexture already produces at load (aliased, no extra bake/memory), installed after that bake so the bake still fills via raycast; falls back to raycast/heightAt outside baked bounds. Added a one-time load-time bilinear-vs-raycast error log/warn to validate bake resolution. Turns the dominant creature terrain-sampling cost into array reads.
